_comment: MECHANISM-TEST config for per-device heterogeneous tp_hardware (feat/per-device-profiles). TP=2 dense Llama-3.1-8B bf16: rank 0 = RTXPRO6000, rank 1 = A6000. Both have real tp2 profiles already (A6000 is a 1.25x-scaled synthetic copy of RTXPRO6000, so it is SLOWER and gates the barrier). This exercises the per-device dense/attention latency+energy path end-to-end NOW, without waiting for ARC V100 tp2 data. Numbers are not physically meaningful (A6000 profile is synthetic); this is a code-path / mechanics check only.
